name: Serrata
description: Serrata was the eighth planet in the Derilyn system. It was a gas giant and had 5 moons. Serrata was a near-star, its mass falling just below the necessary level to make the transition. In the sky of Derilyn, Serrata was a reddish disk as wide as the length of a man's index finger.
lead_paragraphs: Serrata was the eighth planet in the Derilyn system. It was a gas giant and had 5 moons. Serrata was a near-star, its mass falling just below the necessary level to make the transition. In the sky of Derilyn, Serrata was a reddish disk as wide as the length of a man's index finger.
